message:
The other day, I decided it was time to go through our family go-bags—something I thought would be a quick job. Little did I know, my grandkids took it as an invitation for a mini adventure. They started pulling out items, asking what everything was for, and turning the living room into a makeshift camp. 

As we sorted through the flashlights, snacks, and extra blankets, I realized how important it was to include them in our family preparedness plans. It turned into a fun lesson about being ready together, and we even made a game of it. 

Sometimes, it’s the little moments that remind us that readiness can be a family affair. How do you involve your loved ones in your plans?
